app.pages.organisation.title: What abouts us ?
app.pages.organisation.content.paragraph: Aztec was founded by former semi-professional CS:GO and CS2 players, with a dual expertise in the field and in organisation. We know what makes a good tournament, because we've experienced it from both sides. Thanks to more than 20 events organised (Aztec Cup, Arena, IconX), we can now offer reliable and professional services: tailor-made formats, controlled production, quality casting.
Our strength: a human approach, rooted in the reality of the players, and a level of standards that live up to the expectations of our partners.
app.pages.organisation.services.title: Our services
app.pages.organisation.service.event.des:
We can provide you with full support for your event:

  • Planning management and logistics coordination
  • Supervision of admins and technical staff
  • Creation of appropriate formats (groups, brackets, BOs, etc.)
  • Optimising the event to suit the budget
  • Scouting teams to ensure quality posters
app.pages.organisation.service.casting.d:
Aztec offers professional casting services for Counter-Strike 2, combining dynamism, clarity and game expertise. Whether for tournaments, showmatches or community events, we'll be there for you.

  • A lively narrative that adds pace to every round
  • Better audience retention thanks to an engaging cast
  • A more professional image for your event or stream
  • Optimising the event in line with the budgett
  • Added value to the show, even for the uninitiated
app.pages.organisation.service.obs.title: Match/tournament observer
app.pages.organisation.service.obs.descr:
We also offer a spotting service to enhance the broadcasting of your tournaments:

  • Live stream or broadcast (2K 60fps 20,000kbps/S)
  • Fixed and moving camera shots created by us
  • Remote control
  • Instant replay system
  • Live capture of the most memorable moments of the matches
